allow: Bash(node -e "const d = require\('./data/ingredients.json'\); console.log\('Valid. Count:', d.length\); d.forEach\(i => console.log\(i.id, i.name\)\)")

PowerShell($json = Get-Content "data\\ingredients.json" -Raw; $arr = $json | ConvertFrom-Json; Write-Host "Valid. Count: $\($arr.Count\)"; $arr | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "$\($_.id\) $\($_.name\)" })
